metadata.prompt: 第一个画面固定镜头 @图片1 ，情绪化片段，人物 @图片3 吃了一口苹果，手不放下去，悲伤，缓缓自然留下眼泪，随后突然， @图片2 的一只手入画抢走苹果，切镜头 @图片3 站起来对着 @图片2 用 @音频1 音色说：“你有病吧！这是导演的情感表达！”切镜头 @图片2 用 @音频2 中年女人音色说：“吃三分钟苹果就叫情感了？无聊。”说话时把苹果扔进嘴里嚼，此时 @图片3 无奈的神情， @图片4 入画， @图片3 连忙拉着 @图片4 他的胳膊说：“导演你看看他。”说话时 @图片4 的侧脸做出要对 @图片2 发脾气的姿势然后缓缓转身对着 @图片3 用 @音频3 ，语气数落的说：“牛老师说的对！文艺片导演也是要吃饭的，改成快切，名字也不叫白猫了，叫黄牛。”切镜头 @图片4 的侧身握了握 @图片2 的手， @图片3 愣在原地， @图片2 露出笑容

metadata.prompt:
A contemporary experimental minimalist exhibition poster.

### Subject:

A colossal animal from the uploaded reference image breaking through a translucent frosted glass membrane. Preserve the animal's distinctive species, anatomy, facial features, proportions, fur, texture, and recognizable characteristics from the uploaded reference image.

Its enormous eye and massive body slowly emerge into reality, while the environment behind dissolves into a soft blurred shadow. The animal is partially obscured by fogged translucent glass, creating mysterious abstract anatomy through distortion.

Delicate pressure bulges and subtle deformations in the glass suggest the immense force of the creature pushing forward. Only selected areas, such as the eye, part of the head, facial features, limbs, and portions of the body, appear sharper, tactile, and physically protruding through the surface, producing a convincing optical illusion that the animal is penetrating the translucent barrier.

Soft blurred silhouette behind frosted glass, diffused shadow shapes, foggy translucent surface, out-of-focus photography, subtle refraction, delicate translucency, abstract realism, immersive depth illusion.

### Composition:

Minimal cold gray background with a subtle greenish-white tone. Extremely large negative space. The animal occupies only part of the composition, allowing emptiness to dominate.

Asymmetric minimalist composition, generous negative space, precise visual balance, refined proportions, museum-quality contemporary art poster aesthetic.

### Lighting & Mood:

Soft diffused lighting.
High-key photography.
Low contrast.
Quiet atmosphere.
Mysterious yet calm atmosphere.
Conceptual art direction.
Elegant restraint.
Sophisticated minimalism.
Subtle gradients.

No harsh shadows.
No visual clutter.

### Style Keywords:

Contemporary experimental design, minimalist poster, conceptual photography, translucent frosted glass illusion, optical illusion, Swiss graphic design aesthetic, refined luxury minimalism, abstract animal anatomy, atmospheric depth, museum-quality print aesthetic, premium art direction, sophisticated contemporary visual language.

### Reference Image Instructions:

Use the uploaded animal image as the primary visual reference for the subject. Accurately preserve the animal's identity, species, appearance, proportions, distinctive facial characteristics, body structure, fur or skin texture, and overall visual features.

Do not transform the animal into a black cat or any other species. Do not introduce additional animals. The uploaded animal must remain the sole primary subject.

### Output:

Ultra-high-resolution 8K, A2 poster format, portrait orientation, pristine print quality, crisp clean edges, no typography, no letters, no words, no numbers, no logos, no symbols, no captions, no knife, no weapon, no decorative text elements, no unnecessary visual elements.
